acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Flame Spirit, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Smoke-Reach Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Human-sized yellow-orange humanoid fire with no fixed face, smoke-trailing arms, and no feet.
Signature mechanic: Smoke Reach: one flame arm stretches, fades into smoke, and reignites only at full extension.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat mid-range pressure by extending one smoke-trailing arm across a readable lane.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown; T4 alone gains source-supported obsidian shell and molten rock; T5 alone gains its star, corona, and crown.
Directional intake flutes, split smoke ribbons, pressure-shaped flame edges, debris vectors, and a still combustion throat create an aerodynamic grammar beyond ordinary rising heat.
counterplay: Cross behind the extended arm and strike the narrow body before the tip reignites. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown, so the still throat appears between directed gusts; T4 obsidian shell and molten rock expose one intake gap; T5 star, corona, and crown align around a still pressure anchor.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ordinary smoke rise as Wind affinity
identityInvariants: A roughly humanoid upper silhouette dissolves into flame above and tapers or hovers below with no feet.
Temperature remains legible from dull orange through yellow-white to blue-white edges.
Open flame, ember, smoke, and later source-supported obsidian and molten rock stay materially distinct.
Core definition and directed combustion progress from a flicker to a sovereign star while heat remains readable rather than overexposed.
telegraph: The faceless humanoid upper body narrows and one arm turns dark at the tip.
